logTail: Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit.
A woman, maybe 30s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Something walked here regularly, before. The path remembers even if no one does.
"Jesse," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Jesse." You'll remember that.
Jesse: ""How are you holding up? Honestly. No performance.""
You walk out with A person, maybe 50s. Something feels off, but you go anyway.
Halfway there, the shape of it changes. Jesse stops walking. A person, maybe 50s and A person, maybe 30s are suddenly on your other sides — not wandering. Placed.
"Don't make this worse than it is." Jesse won't quite meet your eyes. Their hands are shaking.
🐞 SCENARIO: the walk turned. Three people, placed around you — not wandering. Placed.
RUN, TALK, or FIGHT — each exchange costs. Running is the intended move. They're scared, not killers.
